title: REFLO Worker Activity Input v1
description: Small, replay-safe Temporal activity input. Large bytes stay in object storage and are referenced by immutable descriptors.

title: REFLO Agent Structured Output v1
description: PydanticAI-validated proposal output. Agent output never constitutes approval, Evidence, or authoritative calculation.

title: REFLO Artifact Descriptor v1
description: Internal-only descriptor for immutable or temporary worker artifacts. Browser responses must never expose bucket or objectKey.

title: REFLO Worker Common Types v1
description: Shared scalar, identifier, version, coordinate, source locator, and tool types for REFLO worker contracts.

DecimalString.title: DecimalString
DecimalString.description: Base-10 decimal serialized without exponent notation.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points. Domain validation enforces x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1.

Quad.title: Quad
Quad.description: Four points in PDF user-space order.

Matrix.title: Matrix
Matrix.description: PDF affine matrix [a, b, c, d, e, f].

title: REFLO Evidence Validation Result v1
description: Independent validation of source-backed evidence candidates. Existing source bytes and candidates remain immutable.

title: REFLO File Inspection Result v1
description: Typed result from file-scan before an upload is accepted as an immutable project file.

title: REFLO Mapping Set v1
description: Versioned typed mapping from workbook sources to stable Template IR slots.

title: REFLO Report Materialization Artifact v1
description: Immutable scalar, table, chart, and composite chart snapshots pinned to one report source lineage.

title: REFLO Report and Excel Worker Artifact v1
description: Typed workbook recalculation, render plan, PDF render, validation, and publish artifacts.

title: REFLO Research Worker Result v1
description: Source collection metadata or unverified research candidates. Candidates are not Evidence until independent validation passes.

title: REFLO Runtime Worker Result Payloads v1
description: Strict payloads emitted by the current composite file inspection and research validation activities.

title: REFLO Template IR v1
description: Immutable PDF structure, semantic blocks and slots, physical patch locators, resources, and validation masks.

title: REFLO Validated Value Set v1
description: Immutable approved values with evidence, authority, conversion, and conflict decisions.

title: REFLO Workbook Analysis v1
description: Immutable workbook structure and editable-cell analysis generated by the Excel worker.

charts.description: OOXML chart definitions resolved through worksheet and drawing relationships.

ooxmlSheetId.description: The persistent sheetId attribute from xl/workbook.xml.

relationshipId.description: Workbook relationship id that resolves this worksheet part.

kind.description: How this tabular range candidate was discovered.

title: REFLO Worker Error v1
description: Safe, typed worker failure. stack traces and source content belong in restricted diagnostic artifacts, never in message.
